text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've finally gathered enough members for a full Unity Cup team. At first, our training sessions go well…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, the team starts to fall apart as they become overly considerate of each other's feelings and find themselves constantly walking on eggshells.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The members of Team Zenith, meanwhile, start to demonstrate real results under their strict management, and they seem to fully trust Ms. Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I start to worry whether we really have any chance at winning the Unity Cup.
